text:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: weight-bundle v3.2 promoted to prod in us-west-2. ✅
maya: seeing weird output from the chat model -- lots of garbled tokens and truncation. noticed at ~08:12 UTC.
dan: paging ops-oncall... increasing error rate on model-service.
maya: logs show tokenizer complaints: 
```
ERROR tokenizer: unknown token byte 0xFF at pos 1024
WARN decode: invalid sequence => fallback to <unk>
```
lisa: also seeing 5x latency increase on short requests, 08:12->08:16 window. dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/model-service/latency
support-sam: several customers reported garbled outputs in their support cases, ticket #INC-9421. customer-visible failures ~0.6% of calls (spike).
ops-bot: @dan you are oncall for infra. Page dispatched. :rotating_light:
dan: I'm on it. Canary had weight-bundle v3.2 + tokenizer-config v2.0; looks like the promoted artifact had tokenizer v1.9. Mismatch.
maya: exact failure: weights expect 50k vocab, tokenizer shipped 49,982 entries -> index OOB when decoding.
lisa: that's a deploy metadata mismatch in artifact manifest. digging why the promotion step didn't validate tokenizer hash.
maya: quick impact: some prompts produce junk tokens, some calls abort with "decode error". Not all customers. likely subset using short-batch path.
dan: mitigation options: 1) flip feature flag to route traffic to v3.1 (old bundle), 2) immediate rollback of v3.2 promotion, 3) hotpatch tokenizer in place (risky). Recommend kill-switch flag + rollback.
support-sam: please prioritize flip, we have paying customers experiencing garbled completions.
maya: command to flip feature flag: 
```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  https://controlplane.internal/flags/model-service.use_promoted_weights -d '{"value": false}'
```
ops-bot: running flip...
ops-bot: feature flag updated: model-service.use_promoted_weights = false (propagating) :white_check_mark:
lisa: starting rollback job for weight promotion artifact id=prom-202603170812 v3.2 -> initiating promote revert.
deploy-bot: rollback job queued: rollback-id rb-831234-01. ETA 2m to start draining traffic.
dan: draining done, routing now hitting v3.1 pools. monitor logs for decode errors.
maya: decode error rate dropping. small number of stale hosts still showing failures, clearing caches.
ops-bot: purge KV cache on serving nodes: 
```bash
for host in $(nodeset serving_uswest2); do ssh $host sudo systemctl restart model-service; done
```
lisa: restarted remaining hosts, confirmed tokenizer versions = v2.0 on active pool.
support-sam: message to affected customers drafted and sent: "We detected an incorrect model rollout causing garbled outputs and have reverted to the previous model version. We're investigating root cause and will follow up."
dan: post-rollback metrics: user-facing error rate back to baseline, latency normalized by 08:20 UTC.
maya: root cause likely artifact promotion script skipping tokenizer-hash check when promotion originates from staging tag. moving to add strict manifest validation and a pre-promote smoke test.
lisa: I'll open a follow-up PR to the deploy pipeline to add tokenizer/weight hash cross-check + canary traffic sample decode tests.
ops-bot: incident ticket created: INC-9421, severity P1 (customer-impact). Assigned to maya, lisa for next 24h follow-up.
support-sam: keep me looped for customer updates.
dan: thumbs up. postmortem + timeline will be prepared in #postmortems.
maya: flipping to postmortem mode: timeline, contributing factors, and mitigation plan by EOD. :spiral_notepad:
ops-bot: closing the active pager. No more alerts for this incident. :white_check_mark:
lisa: quick wins: block promotions that don't include tokenizer hash or mismatched artifacts; add a canary decode test with synthetic prompts.
dan: thanks everyone.
support-sam: closing customer tickets as resolved where applicable and noting the rollback.
maya: tagging incident in release notes and adding a fatality check to the promotion workflow.
ops-bot: incident resolved at 8312345978.
